name: PVOutput
tagline: Crowdsourced solar PV generation and consumption time series API
description: PVOutput provides a free, key-authenticated API for reading and writing solar PV system generation and consumption data from a global crowdsourced network of systems. Developers can query live and historical energy, power, weather, and status data for individual systems or aggregates, plus post measurements from inverters and energy monitors.

auth.details: API key via X-Pvoutput-Apikey header and system id via X-Pvoutput-SystemId header; obtain both after free account registration and enabling API access in account settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Registered non-donation accounts: 60 requests/hour per API key for most request types; Get Statistic: 12/hour. Donation mode raises these to 300/hour and 60/hour respectively.
pricing.paid_plans: Donation membership increases API request limits; no traditional paid API plan published

rate_limits: Per API key: 60 requests/hour normally or 300/hour in Donation mode. Get Statistic separately allows 12/hour normally or 60/hour in Donation mode.
use_cases: get latest solar generation status for a PV system
post inverter energy readings to a PVOutput system
fetch historical daily energy output for a system
list public PV systems near a location
get live power generation and consumption time series
